name: notify-shared-record
prompt: Email.Send and SMS.Send in package notify do nearly the same thing. Make both call one package-level function record(sent *[]string, channel, to, text string), which logs "<channel> to <to>" with the standard logger and appends "<to>: <text>" to *sent. What they send and log must not change.

name: notify-optout
prompt: Users can opt out of channels. Add a field OptOut map[string]bool to notify.User, keyed by a channel's name (what Notifier.Name returns). Broadcast does not send on a channel the user opted out of, and that user's summary line lists only the channels it sent on.

name: notify-contacts
prompt: Replace the fields Email and Phone of notify.User with one field Contacts map[string]string, keyed by channel name: "email" for Email's address and "sms" for SMS's phone number. What is sent and logged must not change otherwise.

name: notify-fit
prompt: truncate is used only by SMS. Replace it with a method func (s *SMS) fit(text string) string that cuts text to the 20 bytes a text message holds, and remove truncate. What is sent must not change.

name: notify-batch
prompt: Broadcast should take its users and message as one value. Add a type notify.Batch struct { Users []User; Message Message } and change Broadcast to func Broadcast(c Config, b Batch) []string, updating every caller. What it sends and returns must not change.
